title: Consumer courts can't decide gratuity disputes: Kerala High Court
description: The Kerala High Court recently held that an employee cannot approach consumer dispute rederessal forums to recover gratuity dues from an employer [The Tirur Service Co-operative Bank Ltd v Moideen M].Justice Ziyad Rahman AA explained that an employer is not a 'service provider' nor is an employee a 'consumer' under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
